messages.subject: Brightwater / Pennine Mutual — MSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Please find attached our mark-up of the MSA (v2, tracked). The principal points: (1) clause 11.3 — we have moved the cap to 200% of annual charges; (2) clause 11.4 — the data-protection/confidentiality carve-out should be uncapped; (3) clause 5.2 — service credits should not be the sole remedy; (4) clause 8.3 — we have deleted the supplier's right to use anonymised/aggregated data; and (5) clause 13.2 — our client requires termination for convenience on 30 days' notice.

Happy to discuss.

Amelia Hart
Castle & Vane LLP
